record.paper_title: Free Boundary Minimal Surfaces in the Unit Ball: Recent Advances and Open Questions
record.original_question: Let Σ^k be an immersed free boundary minimal submanifold of the Euclidean unit ball B^n, and let f: B^n → B^n be a conformal diffeomorphism. Is the k-dimensional volume of Σ maximal within its conformal orbit, in the sense that the inequality |f(Σ)| ≤ |Σ| always holds?

evidence.quote: Open Question 8. Let Σ^k be an immersed free boundary minimal submanifold in B^n, and f : B^n → B^n be a conformal diffeomorphism. Is it true that |f(Σ)| ≤ |Σ|?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $B^n = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^n : |x| \le 1\}$ be the closed Euclidean unit ball, and let $\Sigma^k \subset B^n$ be a (smoothly) immersed $k$-dimensional free boundary minimal submanifold; that is, $\Sigma$ has zero mean curvature in $B^n$, its boundary $\partial \Sigma$ lies in $\partial B^n = S^{n-1}$, and $\Sigma$ meets $S^{n-1}$ orthogonally along $\partial \Sigma$. Let $f : B^n \to B^n$ be a conformal diffeomorphism of the ball (equivalently, the restriction to $B^n$ of a Möbius transformation of $\mathbb{R}^n \cup \{\infty\}$ that preserves $B^n$). Denote by $|\,\cdot\,|$ the $k$-dimensional Hausdorff (volume) measure.

Prove or disprove: for every such $\Sigma$ and every such $f$,
$$|f(\Sigma)| \le |\Sigma|.$$
Equivalently, is the $k$-volume of an immersed free boundary minimal submanifold of $B^n$ always maximal within its orbit under the group of conformal self-diffeomorphisms of $B^n$?
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of this conformal-monotonicity question for free boundary minimal submanifolds of the Euclidean unit ball appears in the literature. Recent related work (e.g., monotonicity formulas for minimal submanifolds under Möbius transformations and isoperimetric inequalities for free boundary submanifolds) develops nearby techniques but does not establish the inequality $|f(\Sigma)| \le |\Sigma|$ in general. The question is still listed among open problems on free boundary minimal surfaces in the ball.

status_evidence.title: Monotonicity formulas for minimal submanifolds involving Möbius transformations
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes monotonicity formulas for (weighted) volume of minimal submanifolds within images of concentric balls under Möbius transformations.
status_evidence.claim: Recent related work develops monotonicity formulas under Möbius transformations but does not resolve the conformal-orbit volume maximality question for free boundary minimal submanifolds.

status_evidence.title: Linear isoperimetric inequalities for free boundary submanifolds in a geodesic ball
status_evidence.snippet: Linear isoperimetric inequalities for free boundary submanifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Related isoperimetric inequalities are obtained, but the conformal monotonicity inequality is not established.

status_evidence.title: Free boundary minimal surfaces in the unit ball: recent advances and open questions
status_evidence.snippet: Open Question 8 asks whether |f(Σ)| ≤ |Σ| for any conformal diffeomorphism f of the ball.
status_evidence.claim: The question is posed as an open problem in the literature on free boundary minimal surfaces.
